title: Inspect's Sources tab sorts every fact by how sure we are
items: Sources opens with a count, like Glessner House's 99 facts: 50 Attested, 14 Inferred, 35 Reconstructed.
Each fact sits under its grade. Tap one to see why we think so and which sources it rests on.
Sources are named by their titles and marked from the time or written later. The full citation folds away underneath.
Liberties is its own section, listing by name every choice we made without a source.
The Overview's Confidence meter counts the same facts, so the two always agree.
